categories.name: Film Stocks
categories.description: Classic analog film emulations with authentic H&D curves and organic grain

categories.name: Cinematic
categories.description: Iconic movie looks with professional layer compositing

kodak_portra_400.name: Portra 400
kodak_portra_400.subtitle: Kodak
kodak_portra_400.description: The king of portrait film — warm skin tones, soft highlight rolloff, pastel shadows
kodak_portra_400.signature: Warm pastel shadows with buttery skin tones and a soft shoulder rolloff that wraps highlights in silk
kodak_portra_400.famous_for: The world's most popular portrait film since the 1990s — the default choice for wedding, fashion, and editorial photographers who want flattering skin tones with minimal post-processing

kodak_portra_160.name: Portra 160
kodak_portra_160.subtitle: Kodak
kodak_portra_160.description: Fine-grain portrait film — neutral tones, exceptional skin rendering, subtle warmth
kodak_portra_160.signature: Ultra-fine grain with neutral-warm color accuracy and the gentlest tonal transitions in any film stock
kodak_portra_160.famous_for: The studio portrait and architectural photographer's film — chosen when absolute fidelity matters more than character, with the finest grain of any color negative film

kodak_gold_200.name: Gold 200
kodak_gold_200.subtitle: Kodak
kodak_gold_200.description: Consumer classic — punchy warmth, saturated yellows, nostalgic amber cast
kodak_gold_200.signature: Punchy amber-yellow warmth with boosted saturation and a golden glow that screams summer nostalgia
kodak_gold_200.famous_for: The consumer film that defined casual photography for decades — every family vacation, birthday party, and sunset from the 1980s through 2000s was shot on Gold

kodak_ektar_100.name: Ektar 100
kodak_ektar_100.subtitle: Kodak
kodak_ektar_100.description: Ultra-vivid fine grain — hyper-saturated reds and blues, punchy landscapes
kodak_ektar_100.signature: Hyper-vivid reds and blues with razor-sharp grain and a punchy mid-tone contrast that makes landscapes pop
kodak_ektar_100.famous_for: Kodak's finest-grain color negative film and the sharpest in its class — landscape and travel photographers' secret weapon for ultra-saturated, vibrant images

kodak_trix_400.name: Tri-X 400
kodak_trix_400.subtitle: Kodak
kodak_trix_400.description: The quintessential B&W — rich tonal range, distinctive grain, documentary soul
kodak_trix_400.signature: Rich Zone System tonality with beautiful mid-tone separation, pushed grain texture, and luminous highlight rolloff
kodak_trix_400.famous_for: The most iconic black-and-white film in history — used by virtually every major photojournalist and street photographer since the 1950s, from Robert Frank to Sebastião Salgado

fuji_pro400h.name: Pro 400H
fuji_pro400h.subtitle: Fujifilm
fuji_pro400h.description: Airy pastel portraits — cool undertones, green-blue shadow tint, ethereal highlights
fuji_pro400h.signature: Cool green-blue shadow tones with ethereal overexposed highlights and pastel color rendering
fuji_pro400h.famous_for: The wedding and portrait photographer's alternative to Portra — beloved for its unique green-shifted shadows and dreamy, overexposed aesthetic that defined a generation of bridal photography

fuji_superia.name: Superia 400
fuji_superia.subtitle: Fujifilm
fuji_superia.description: Everyday consumer film — warm with green shadow shift, cheerful and nostalgic
fuji_superia.signature: Cool-toned everyday color with characteristic green bias, moderate grain, and punchy consumer saturation
fuji_superia.famous_for: Fuji's mass-market workhorse film — the green-tinged alternative to Kodak Gold that gave millions of snapshots their distinctive cool-warm tension

ilford_hp5.name: HP5 Plus
ilford_hp5.subtitle: Ilford
ilford_hp5.description: Classic B&W — smooth tonal range, medium contrast, beautiful organic grain
ilford_hp5.signature: Smooth mid-tones with gentle grain and a wide exposure latitude that gracefully handles pushed processing
ilford_hp5.famous_for: Britain's workhorse B&W film — HP5's forgiving exposure latitude and smooth grain made it the go-to for photojournalists and students who needed reliability in any lighting condition

ilford_delta_3200.name: Delta 3200
ilford_delta_3200.subtitle: Ilford
ilford_delta_3200.description: High-speed B&W — extreme grain, dramatic contrast, night photography soul
ilford_delta_3200.signature: Extreme high-ISO grain with deep shadows and a moody, low-light atmosphere that embraces noise as texture
ilford_delta_3200.famous_for: The film for impossible lighting — concert photographers, nightlife documentarians, and anyone shooting handheld in near-darkness rely on Delta 3200's beautiful structured grain

cinestill_800t.name: CineStill 800T
cinestill_800t.subtitle: Tungsten Neon
cinestill_800t.description: Cinema tungsten film with halation — blue shadows, warm highlights, red bloom
cinestill_800t.signature: Warm halation bloom around light sources with tungsten-balanced blue shadows and cinema-grade color rendering
cinestill_800t.famous_for: Hollywood motion picture film stock (Kodak Vision3 500T) with the remjet layer removed — the distinctive red halation around streetlights and neon signs made it an Instagram sensation and the defining night photography film of the 2020s

cross_processed.name: Cross Process
cross_processed.subtitle: E-6 in C-41
cross_processed.description: Wild color shifts from cross-processing — cyan shadows, yellow-green highlights
cross_processed.signature: Wild color shifts with boosted saturation — greens go electric, shadows turn magenta, and contrast punches through the roof
cross_processed.famous_for: The happy accident of developing slide film in C-41 chemistry — embraced by lomographers, punk zine photographers, and 90s fashion editorials for its unpredictable, psychedelic color explosions

wong_kar_wai.name: Wong Kar-wai
wong_kar_wai.subtitle: 王家卫
wong_kar_wai.description: Neon-soaked amber & teal, crushed blacks, romantic warmth
wong_kar_wai.signature: Saturated neon-soaked warmth with smeared motion, deep teal shadows, and hyper-vivid reds and greens
wong_kar_wai.famous_for: The visual language of longing — Christopher Doyle's cinematography in 'In the Mood for Love' and 'Chungking Express' created the most imitated mood palette in modern cinema and photography

wes_anderson.name: Wes Anderson
wes_anderson.subtitle: Pastel Symmetry
wes_anderson.description: Candy pastels, flat contrast, warm retro whimsy — Grand Budapest vibes
wes_anderson.signature: Carefully curated pastel palette with symmetrical framing, whimsical warmth, and storybook saturation
wes_anderson.famous_for: The most recognizable directorial aesthetic in cinema — 'The Grand Budapest Hotel' and 'Moonrise Kingdom' spawned an entire design movement of carefully color-coordinated, symmetrical compositions

blade_runner.name: Blade Runner
blade_runner.subtitle: Cyberpunk Noir
blade_runner.description: Teal shadows, orange highlights, crushed blacks — dystopian neon rain
blade_runner.signature: Teal shadows and orange highlights with crushed blacks, atmospheric haze, and a cold industrial palette
blade_runner.famous_for: The definitive cyberpunk aesthetic — Jordan Cronenweth's and Roger Deakins' cinematography across both Blade Runner films established the teal-and-orange color grading that dominates modern blockbuster cinema

tarantino.name: Tarantino
tarantino.subtitle: Grindhouse
tarantino.description: High saturation, punchy 70s grindhouse — Kill Bill yellows, boosted reds
tarantino.signature: High-contrast punchy color with saturated reds, warm golden tones, and a retro exploitation film grit
tarantino.famous_for: The visual intensity of Tarantino's films — from the warm California glow of 'Pulp Fiction' to the blood-red drama of 'Kill Bill,' his palette combines grindhouse grit with lush saturated color

ghibli.name: Studio Ghibli
ghibli.subtitle: 宮崎駿
ghibli.description: Soft pastoral warmth, lush greens, gentle sky blues — dreamy nostalgia
ghibli.signature: Soft pastoral warmth with lush boosted greens, gentle sky blues, and a luminous watercolor quality
ghibli.famous_for: The enchanting color palette of Studio Ghibli's hand-painted animation — 'My Neighbor Totoro' and 'Spirited Away' created a visual language where nature glows with magical warmth that has become synonymous with wholesome beauty

nordic_noir.name: Nordic Noir
nordic_noir.subtitle: Scandinavian Cold
nordic_noir.description: Icy blue-gray desaturation, cold clinical tones, overcast mood
nordic_noir.signature: Desaturated cool tones with blue-grey shadows, muted highlights, and an oppressive atmospheric weight
nordic_noir.famous_for: The bleak beauty of Scandinavian crime drama — 'The Killing,' 'The Bridge,' and 'The Girl with the Dragon Tattoo' established a visual language of cold desolation that permeates modern thriller cinematography

terrence_malick.name: Terrence Malick
terrence_malick.subtitle: Golden Hour
terrence_malick.description: Magic hour glow, ethereal warmth, hazy highlights — nature poetry in light
terrence_malick.signature: Golden-hour naturalism with soft backlit halos, earth tones, and an almost spiritual luminosity
terrence_malick.famous_for: Cinema's greatest natural-light poetry — 'The Tree of Life,' 'Days of Heaven,' and 'Badlands' capture magic hour with a reverence that makes every frame look like a Renaissance painting bathed in divine light

hitchcock.name: Hitchcock
hitchcock.subtitle: Suspense Noir
hitchcock.description: Dramatic B&W, deep shadows, suspenseful contrast — Psycho and Vertigo
hitchcock.signature: High-contrast noir B&W with deep blacks, dramatic side-lighting, and a suspenseful, shadowy atmosphere
hitchcock.famous_for: The master of suspense's visual grammar — 'Psycho,' 'Vertigo,' and 'Rear Window' defined how shadows and contrast create tension, influencing every thriller made since

moriyama.name: Moriyama
moriyama.subtitle: 森山大道
moriyama.description: Extreme high-contrast B&W, heavy grain — raw urban street energy
moriyama.signature: Extreme high-contrast B&W with heavy grain, blown highlights, deep crushed blacks, and raw confrontational energy
moriyama.famous_for: The most radical street photographer alive — Daido Moriyama's 'are-bure-boke' (rough, blurred, out-of-focus) aesthetic rejected technical perfection for raw emotional truth, redefining what a photograph can be

fan_ho.name: Fan Ho
fan_ho.subtitle: 何藩
fan_ho.description: Dramatic Hong Kong light & shadow — geometric, high contrast B&W with warmth
fan_ho.signature: Geometric light and shadow with dramatic directional beams, silhouettes, and a painterly chiaroscuro quality
fan_ho.famous_for: The master of light in Hong Kong — Fan Ho's photographs of 1950s-60s Hong Kong transformed narrow alleys and crowded streets into dramatic compositions of light and geometry that bridge photography and fine art

saul_leiter.name: Saul Leiter
saul_leiter.subtitle: Through Glass
saul_leiter.description: Muted colors through rain-streaked glass — soft, desaturated, intimate reds
saul_leiter.signature: Muted desaturated palette with selective red accents, rain-streaked abstraction, and intimate bokeh layers
saul_leiter.famous_for: The pioneer of color street photography — Saul Leiter's rain-soaked New York images shot through taxi windows and umbrellas created a painterly, abstract approach decades before color photography was taken seriously as art

vivian_maier.name: Vivian Maier
vivian_maier.subtitle: Street Portrait
vivian_maier.description: Clean B&W street photography — moderate contrast, silvery tones, observant eye
vivian_maier.signature: Sharp documentary clarity with rich mid-tone detail, natural contrast, and an unflinching observational eye
vivian_maier.famous_for: The greatest undiscovered photographer of the 20th century — Vivian Maier's 100,000+ negatives, found in a storage locker after her death, revealed a lifetime of brilliant street photography that rivaled the masters

moody_natural.name: Moody Natural
moody_natural.subtitle: Dark Editorial
moody_natural.description: Rich shadows, warm skin tones, desaturated greens — modern editorial mood
moody_natural.signature: Warm desaturated tones with lifted shadows, muted greens, and an organic lifestyle feel
moody_natural.famous_for: The dominant Instagram and TikTok aesthetic of the 2020s — lifestyle influencers, wedding photographers, and brand campaigns all gravitate toward this warm-but-muted look that feels simultaneously polished and effortless

soft_film.name: Soft Film
soft_film.subtitle: Polished Nostalgia
soft_film.description: Light grain, pastel tones, low contrast, airy feel — the dominant 2026 look
soft_film.signature: Gentle pastel fade with lifted blacks, soft highlight bloom, and a dreamy analog nostalgia
soft_film.famous_for: The 'film look' for digital — this aesthetic bridges the gap between clean digital and analog warmth, popular with portrait photographers and lifestyle bloggers who want film character without the unpredictability

clean_bright.name: Clean & Bright
clean_bright.subtitle: Modern Commercial
clean_bright.description: Bright, slightly cool, minimal processing — clean commercial look
clean_bright.signature: Crisp whites, lifted exposure, minimal color cast, and an airy, open feeling
clean_bright.famous_for: The clean editorial standard — product photographers, minimalist bloggers, and Scandinavian design brands use this bright, high-key aesthetic for images that feel fresh, modern, and uncluttered

warm_vintage_bw.name: Warm Vintage B&W
warm_vintage_bw.subtitle: Sepia Soul
warm_vintage_bw.description: Warm-tinted B&W, sepia undertones, moderate grain — timeless nostalgia
warm_vintage_bw.signature: Sepia-toned B&W with warm brown shadows, soft contrast, and a timeless antique quality
warm_vintage_bw.famous_for: The warmth of vintage prints — this look evokes 19th-century albumen prints and early daguerreotypes, popular for heritage projects, romantic portraits, and fine art prints that feel like treasured heirlooms

faded_editorial.name: Faded Editorial
faded_editorial.subtitle: Fashion Magazine
faded_editorial.description: Heavily faded, cool teal shadows, crushed blacks — high fashion editorial
faded_editorial.signature: Washed-out highlights with muted midtones, subtle color shifts, and a high-fashion editorial distance
faded_editorial.famous_for: The look of modern fashion editorial — magazines like Dazed, i-D, and Vogue Italia use this faded, slightly disconnected aesthetic to create images that feel aspirational yet understated

ansel_adams.name: Ansel Adams
ansel_adams.subtitle: Zone System
ansel_adams.description: Zone System mastery — full tonal range B&W with luminous highlights and true blacks
ansel_adams.signature: Full Zone System tonality with luminous highlights, true blacks, and exquisite midtone separation across every tonal zone
ansel_adams.famous_for: The father of modern landscape photography — Ansel Adams' Zone System technique and his majestic images of Yosemite and the American West defined how we see wilderness and established photography as fine art

cartier_bresson.name: Cartier-Bresson
cartier_bresson.subtitle: The Decisive Moment
cartier_bresson.description: Clean geometric B&W — sharp decisive moments with balanced tones and subtle grain
cartier_bresson.signature: Clean geometric compositions with balanced silvery tones, moderate grain, and razor-sharp decisive-moment clarity
cartier_bresson.famous_for: The inventor of modern photojournalism — Henri Cartier-Bresson's concept of 'the decisive moment' and his perfectly composed street photographs with a Leica defined the art of candid photography for the 20th century

robert_frank.name: Robert Frank
robert_frank.subtitle: The Americans
robert_frank.description: Raw gritty B&W — heavy grain, crushed shadows, unflinching American documentary
robert_frank.signature: Heavy pushed grain with crushed inky shadows, blown highlights, and a raw unflinching energy that feels ripped from the road
robert_frank.famous_for: The book that changed photography forever — Robert Frank's 'The Americans' broke every rule of clean photojournalism with its blurry, grainy, off-kilter frames, revealing a poetic and troubled America no one had shown before

salgado.name: Salgado
salgado.subtitle: Epic Humanitarian
salgado.description: Epic humanitarian B&W — sweeping tonal range, rich shadow detail, monumental grain
salgado.signature: Monumental B&W with sweeping tonal range, sculpted shadow detail, and a warm selenium undertone that gives every frame epic grandeur
salgado.famous_for: The most important documentary photographer alive — Sebastiao Salgado's decade-long projects like 'Genesis' and 'Workers' chronicle the human condition and natural world with a scale and beauty that transforms photojournalism into fine art

steve_mccurry.name: Steve McCurry
steve_mccurry.subtitle: Kodachrome Master
steve_mccurry.description: Vibrant Kodachrome documentary — saturated warm tones, intense reds, global storytelling
steve_mccurry.signature: Saturated Kodachrome warmth with intense reds and golds, deep shadow anchoring, and vivid color that pops off the frame
steve_mccurry.famous_for: The last great Kodachrome shooter — Steve McCurry's 'Afghan Girl' became the most recognized photograph in National Geographic's history, and his vivid color documentary work across Asia defined a generation of travel photography

eggleston.name: William Eggleston
eggleston.subtitle: Dye Transfer
eggleston.description: Dye-transfer saturated color — rich reds, elevated mundane, democratic camera
eggleston.signature: Hyper-saturated dye-transfer reds and deep color purity that transforms gas stations and supermarkets into luminous color-field paintings
eggleston.famous_for: The father of color art photography — William Eggleston's dye-transfer prints at MoMA in 1976 scandalized the art world by proving that mundane everyday subjects in the American South could be elevated to high art through sheer force of color

leibovitz.name: Annie Leibovitz
leibovitz.subtitle: Dramatic Portrait
leibovitz.description: Dramatic editorial portraits — rich deep shadows, warm skin, painterly light
leibovitz.signature: Dramatic painterly light with rich velvet shadows, slightly desaturated warmth, and a heavy vignette that sculpts the subject like a Renaissance master
leibovitz.famous_for: The most famous portrait photographer in the world — Annie Leibovitz's iconic images for Rolling Stone and Vanity Fair, from John Lennon to the Queen, defined celebrity portraiture with theatrical lighting and elaborate conceptual setups

ernst_haas.name: Ernst Haas
ernst_haas.subtitle: Color Pioneer
ernst_haas.description: Color abstraction pioneer — extreme warmth, motion blur, painterly Kodachrome glow
ernst_haas.signature: Painterly Kodachrome warmth with extreme golden tones, soft washed highlights, and an abstract color-field quality that blurs the line between photography and painting
ernst_haas.famous_for: The first color photography artist — Ernst Haas pioneered color as a creative medium in the 1950s when it was dismissed as commercial, and his abstract motion studies and vibrant Kodachrome images opened the door for every color photographer who followed

rinko_kawauchi.name: Rinko Kawauchi
rinko_kawauchi.subtitle: Illuminance
rinko_kawauchi.description: Ethereal Japanese light — overexposed softness, lifted shadows, delicate whisper of color
rinko_kawauchi.signature: Blown ethereal highlights with deeply lifted shadows, barely-there color, and a luminous overexposed softness that makes everyday moments feel sacred
rinko_kawauchi.famous_for: Japan's poet of light — Rinko Kawauchi's radically soft, overexposed photographs of insects, bubbles, and fleeting moments redefined contemporary Japanese photography with an intimate spiritual quality that finds the extraordinary in the overlooked

slim_aarons.name: Slim Aarons
slim_aarons.subtitle: Poolside Glamour
slim_aarons.description: Golden poolside glamour — warm Kodachrome glow, sun-drenched leisure, aspirational color
slim_aarons.signature: Sun-drenched Kodachrome warmth with golden highlights, dropped blues, and a buttery glow that makes every scene look like an eternal summer afternoon
slim_aarons.famous_for: The photographer of 'attractive people doing attractive things in attractive places' — Slim Aarons' poolside images of high society in Palm Beach, Capri, and the Riviera defined aspirational glamour photography and remain the most pinned travel images on the internet

gordon_parks.name: Gordon Parks
gordon_parks.subtitle: Dignified Vision
gordon_parks.description: Rich editorial color — dignified warmth, Kodachrome depth, powerful storytelling light
gordon_parks.signature: Rich editorial warmth with dignified color depth, controlled shadow warmth, and a luminosity that honors its subjects with quiet power
gordon_parks.famous_for: The first Black photographer at Life magazine — Gordon Parks used his camera as a weapon against poverty and racism, creating iconic color essays that combined artistic brilliance with social activism and paved the way for generations of Black visual artists

nan_goldin.name: Nan Goldin
nan_goldin.subtitle: Intimate Snapshot
nan_goldin.description: Intimate tungsten amber — on-camera flash warmth, heavy grain, confessional snapshot
nan_goldin.signature: Intense tungsten amber cast with heavily lifted shadows, on-camera flash harshness, and grainy snapshot intimacy that feels like a confessional diary
nan_goldin.famous_for: The most influential diarist photographer of the 20th century — Nan Goldin's 'Ballad of Sexual Dependency' slideshow documented her intimate circle of lovers, drag queens, and addicts in 1980s New York with unflinching honesty that transformed personal photography into high art

meyerowitz.name: Joel Meyerowitz
meyerowitz.subtitle: Cape Light
meyerowitz.description: Cape Cod golden light — gentle warm glow, soft highlights, luminous late-afternoon color
meyerowitz.signature: Gentle golden-hour warmth with luminous faded highlights, soft contrast, and a late-afternoon glow that bathes every scene in Cape Cod light
meyerowitz.famous_for: A pioneer of large-format color street photography — Joel Meyerowitz's 'Cape Light' captured the luminous quality of natural light on Cape Cod with an 8x10 camera, creating images of such gentle radiance that they helped legitimize color photography as fine art alongside Eggleston

alex_webb.name: Alex Webb
alex_webb.subtitle: Tropical Complexity
alex_webb.description: Complex tropical color — deep saturated layers, teal shadows, explosive warmth
alex_webb.signature: Explosively saturated tropical color with deep teal shadows, golden highlight warmth, and dense multi-layered compositions that reward extended viewing
alex_webb.famous_for: The master of tropical color complexity — Alex Webb's Magnum photographs layer multiple subjects in deep saturated color across Mexico, Haiti, and the Caribbean, creating images so dense with information and color that they collapse foreground and background into a single vibrant plane

crewdson.name: Gregory Crewdson
crewdson.subtitle: Suburban Twilight
crewdson.description: Blue-hour suburban eerie — cold cinematic light, theatrical fog, uncanny atmosphere
crewdson.signature: Cold blue-hour atmosphere with desaturated suburban pallor, deep theatrical shadows, heavy cinematic vignette, and an uncanny fog that makes ordinary streets feel like David Lynch film stills
crewdson.famous_for: The filmmaker who makes photographs — Gregory Crewdson stages elaborate cinematic productions with Hollywood lighting crews, fog machines, and entire dressed sets to create single twilight images of American suburbia that feel like stills from a psychological thriller that was never made

martin_parr.name: Martin Parr
martin_parr.subtitle: Flash Pop Art
martin_parr.description: Flash pop art — harsh on-camera flash, hyper-saturated color, darkly comic observation
martin_parr.signature: Harsh flash-lit hyper-saturation with blown specular highlights, punchy double-S contrast, and aggressively warm color that turns everyday scenes into lurid pop art
martin_parr.famous_for: Britain's sharpest visual satirist — Martin Parr's close-up ring-flash photographs of food, tourists, and consumer culture for Magnum combine garish hyper-real color with darkly comic observation, turning the banality of modern life into a relentless pop art critique

fincher.name: David Fincher
fincher.subtitle: 大卫·芬奇
fincher.description: Green-teal desaturated sickly palette of obsessive procedural thrillers
fincher.signature: Sickly green-teal desaturation with crushed shadows and clinical precision
fincher.famous_for: The oppressive green-teal palette of Se7en and Zodiac, where every frame feels like evidence under fluorescent light. Fincher's obsessive color control turns ordinary spaces into psychological traps.

kubrick.name: Stanley Kubrick
kubrick.subtitle: 斯坦利·库布里克
kubrick.description: Cold symmetrical precision with cool blue undertones and razor-sharp clarity
kubrick.signature: Cold blue precision where every frame is a mathematically composed tableau
kubrick.famous_for: The unsettling sterility of 2001: A Space Odyssey and The Shining, where perfect symmetry and cool tones create a world that feels observed rather than lived in.

winding_refn.name: Nicolas Winding Refn
winding_refn.subtitle: 尼古拉斯·温丁·雷弗恩
winding_refn.description: Extreme neon noir with magenta shadows and cyan highlights bleeding into darkness
winding_refn.signature: Neon-soaked noir where magenta and cyan bleed through inky darkness
winding_refn.famous_for: The hypnotic neon fever dream of Drive and Only God Forgives, where Bangkok nightscapes and LA streets dissolve into pure chromatic sensation. Color becomes emotion made visible.

sofia_coppola.name: Sofia Coppola
sofia_coppola.subtitle: 索菲亚·科波拉
sofia_coppola.description: Pastel dreamy haze with lifted blacks and a soft pink whisper throughout
sofia_coppola.signature: Pastel dreamscape where reality dissolves into soft pink light and faded luxury
sofia_coppola.famous_for: The ethereal loneliness of Lost in Translation and Marie Antoinette, where overexposed pastels and gauzy light create a world of beautiful isolation. Every frame feels like a memory already fading.

park_chanwook.name: Park Chan-wook
park_chanwook.subtitle: 朴赞郁
park_chanwook.description: Saturated operatic palette with rich greens and warm golds for baroque revenge
park_chanwook.signature: Saturated operatic grandeur where deep greens and golds frame baroque revenge
park_chanwook.famous_for: The lush visual excess of Oldboy and The Handmaiden, where every frame is a painterly composition dripping with jewel-toned intensity. Violence and beauty are inseparable.

tarkovsky.name: Andrei Tarkovsky
tarkovsky.subtitle: 安德烈·塔可夫斯基
tarkovsky.description: Muted poetic earth tones with sepia-green shadows and organic film texture
tarkovsky.signature: Muted earth-tone poetry where light itself becomes a spiritual presence
tarkovsky.famous_for: The transcendent stillness of Stalker and Nostalghia, where desaturated greens and browns create landscapes that feel like fading memories. Time moves differently in Tarkovsky's muted palette.

zhang_yimou.name: Zhang Yimou
zhang_yimou.subtitle: 张艺谋
zhang_yimou.description: Bold saturated reds and warm ambers of epic Chinese visual storytelling
zhang_yimou.signature: Blazing reds and warm golds that transform the frame into a living Chinese painting
zhang_yimou.famous_for: The breathtaking color choreography of Hero and Raise the Red Lantern, where saturated reds carry narrative weight and emotional force. Each color tells a story within the story.

kurosawa.name: Akira Kurosawa
kurosawa.subtitle: 黑泽明
kurosawa.description: High-contrast black and white with deep blacks and luminous silver highlights
kurosawa.signature: Stark monochrome power where deep blacks and silver highlights carve drama from light
kurosawa.famous_for: The monumental black-and-white compositions of Seven Samurai and Rashomon, where extreme contrast and dynamic weather create images of almost mythic power.

almodovar.name: Pedro Almodovar
almodovar.subtitle: 佩德罗·阿莫多瓦
almodovar.description: Bold warm Spanish palette with saturated reds and yellows in theatrical interiors
almodovar.signature: Bold warm primaries that turn domestic interiors into melodramatic stage sets
almodovar.famous_for: The fearless color saturation of All About My Mother and Volver, where candy-red walls, sunflower yellows, and fuchsia wardrobes create an emotional landscape as vivid as the characters.

del_toro.name: Guillermo del Toro
del_toro.subtitle: 吉尔莫·德尔·托罗
del_toro.description: Gothic amber and teal split toning with halation glow and deep crushed shadows
del_toro.signature: Gothic fairy tale where teal shadows and amber warmth frame the monstrous and the magical
del_toro.famous_for: The dark romanticism of Pan's Labyrinth and Crimson Peak, where cold teal horrors lurk in shadows while golden amber light promises safety that may never come.

michael_mann.name: Michael Mann
michael_mann.subtitle: 迈克尔·曼
michael_mann.description: Digital night blue-teal with coarse grain and desaturated urban cool
michael_mann.signature: Digital blue-teal nightscape where city lights dissolve into electronic cool
michael_mann.famous_for: The pioneering digital cinematography of Collateral and Miami Vice, where the raw texture of early HD captures LA and Miami nights with a cold, immediate intimacy no film stock could match.

argento.name: Dario Argento
argento.subtitle: 达里奥·阿基多
argento.description: Extreme Italian giallo with vivid bleeding primaries and halation-soaked highlights
argento.signature: Fever-dream primaries where blood reds and electric blues bleed through halation into nightmares
argento.famous_for: The psychedelic horror of Suspiria and Deep Red, where impossibly vivid reds and blues wash through baroque interiors like colored spotlights in a waking nightmare. Giallo's most extreme visual stylist.
